In book seven of the Dufort Dynasty series by bestselling author Juliette N Banks, Amelia Dufort, a wealthy artist, falls for a dashing man during the festive season only to discover he was hiding a heartbreaking secret.

Amelia Dufort

There I was, a glass of Cristal in my hand at an art gallery, minding my own business. Next minute I'm in his bed. Those ten days over Christmas were the happiest, most romantic, and without doubt the most sexually intimate of my life.

My heart bursting with love. My body alive with his touch.

Jack Rutherford. The sexy and powerful bachelor, and US senator, had stolen my heart. Until the truth slid to the surface destroying everything in a single moment.

Jack

The moment I laid eyes on Amelia I knew I had to have her. Own her. Consume her.

I'm an influential man, but because of her surname, she's not easily impressed by power. So with every smile I earn, and every blush I garner I feel like f*cking Superman. I want this woman. I mean to make her mine.

Then my past mistakes catch up with me and I thought I had time to fix it. I was wrong. Now, I must decide what's more important; Amelia, or exposing my blackmailers and destroying my high-profile career?

Naughty Festivities is book seven in the steamy Dufort Dynasty series. It's part billionaire, part romantic suspense, and will appeal to readers who like spicy books with a strong storyline, sexy powerful heroes, witty dialogue, heart-clenching moments, and a delicious happy ever after.
